title.zh: 玄学台 · DeepSeek Harness 四门玄学工作台

description.en: Bazi, Liuyao, Ziwei and Vedic as one installable DeepSeek Harness plugin: a left-sidebar studio page, an agent preset, and the four interpretation skills plus their practice layer. Add this index once; new versions show up as updates in the Plugins page.
description.zh: 把八字、六爻、紫微、吠陀四门做成一个可安装的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：左栏工作台页、智能体预设，以及四门解读技能与实践层。索引地址只需添加一次，之后有新版本会在插件页出现「更新」。

description.en: Adds a 玄学 (Metaphysics) page to the left sidebar that turns the four bundled skills (Bazi, Liuyao, Ziwei, Vedic v5.3 with its Prashna module) plus the practice-layer skill xuanxue-orchestra into one workflow. Fate reading and divination are two axes: fate reads a natal chart (Bazi, Ziwei, Vedic), divination casts for one question (Liuyao with the user's own toss, or a Vedic prashna chart from the question moment and place, no birth data). Ask states the question only; the agent triages it, picks a minimal sufficient set, runs each system independently, cross-fits them (shared support, single-system support, conflicts with resolution conditions, gaps) and then reports or discusses. A single system can also be pinned with a validated parameter card. The case archive reads xuanxue-cases/index.json and each case.json to show conclusions, evidence, confidence and verification state, the cross-fit block, timing and the next review date, with one-click follow-up and outcome review. Runtime reads xuanxue-skills/health.json to show the calculators' status and start a health check. Sessions start under the Xuanxue agent preset; the skills ship inside the plugin under skills/.
description.zh: 在左侧导航新增「玄学」整页工作台，把四个内置技能（八字 bazi-core、六爻 liuyao-core、紫微 ziwei-core、吠陀 vedic v5.3 含 Prashna 卜卦）与配套的实践层技能 xuanxue-orchestra 串成一条工作流。算命与卜卦分两轴：算命走八字/紫微/吠陀本命盘，卜卦走六爻（用户摇卦）或吠陀 Prashna 提问盘（提问时刻＋地点，不需生辰）。①提问台：只陈述问题，你先把问题分诊（命还是卜）、选最少充分集、独立跑各门、做交叉拟合（共同支持/单门支持/冲突与分辨/信息缺口），再给结论或一起讨论；也可指定单一法门并做参数卡校验。②命例档案：读 xuanxue-cases/index.json 与各案 case.json，显示结论、证据、置信与验证状态、交叉拟合、应期与下次检查日，可一键追问或复盘应验。③运行态：读 xuanxue-skills/health.json 展示四门脚本与解释器状态并可一键体检。会话以「玄学」代理预设启动，技能随插件内置在 skills/ 下。
